About SG Softech

Big on understanding.
Personal in our approach.

SG Softech is a Nagpur-based software company helping organizations turn everyday complexity into simpler, more connected operations.

Our work spans diagnostic centres, hospitals, pharmacies, educational institutions and growing businesses. Whether you need a management system or something built from the ground up, we bring the technology and the ongoing support together.

Meet your next software partner

Good questions. Clear answers.

Before we get started.

Still have a question?
We're happy to help

Can I see a demo before deciding?

Yes. Request a free demo and tell us which solution you're interested in. Our team will discuss your workflow and arrange a relevant walkthrough.

Can you adapt software to our business?

We offer industry-focused systems and custom software development. We review your requirements to agree the appropriate configuration, modules or custom development before implementation.

What does implementation and support include?

Setup, data migration, training, integrations, maintenance and support depend on the agreed project scope and support plan. We'll work through these with you before you commit.

How much will our solution cost?

Pricing depends on the solution, required modules, locations, users and customization. Contact us for a proposal based on your requirements rather than a one-size-fits-all package.

Do you build websites and mobile apps too?

Yes. We provide website development, hosting and maintenance, along with custom web applications and Android and iOS app development.
